Review fixes: landscape validation

This preview checks the repaired tied-value surface and weighting/concatenation. The cup depths and bootstrap units now follow the supplied network settings.

Weighted transition landscape

d <- data.frame(T1=c('A','A','B'),T2=c('A','B','A'),
                T3=c('A',NA,'B'),T4=c('B',NA,'A'))
n <- build_network(d,method='relative',params=list(weighted=TRUE))
print(n$weights)
##           A         B
## A 0.3333333 0.6666667
## B 1.0000000 0.0000000
land <- stability_landscape(n,iter=50,seed=1)
summary(land)
##     group state     depth ci_lower ci_upper dwell      stay share n_from
## 1 network     A 0.4054651        0 1.042067   1.5 0.3333333   0.6    1.5
## 2 network     B 0.0000000        0 0.000000   1.0 0.0000000   0.4    0.5
##   resamples
## 1        50
## 2        31
plot(land)

Concatenated sequence landscape

n <- build_network(d[c('T1','T2')],method='relative',params=list(concat=3))
print(n$weights)
##           A         B
## A 0.6666667 0.3333333
## B 0.5000000 0.5000000
land <- stability_landscape(n,iter=20,seed=1)
summary(land)
##     group state     depth  ci_lower  ci_upper dwell      stay     share n_from
## 1 network     A 1.0986123 1.0986123 1.0986123     3 0.6666667 0.6666667      3
## 2 network     B 0.6931472 0.6931472 0.6931472     2 0.5000000 0.3333333      2
##   resamples
## 1        20
## 2        20
plot(land)

Nonconstant entropy with equal trimmed percentiles

This input previously returned a surface that failed to plot. The axis now uses the full range when the trimmed endpoints coincide. Thin slices retain the existing warning rather than concealing their limited support.

s <- as.data.frame(matrix(rep(c('A','B','A','B'),each=21),nrow=21))
s[21,] <- c('A','A','B','A')
a <- landscape_surface(s,k=5)
## Warning: 12 of 25 slices rest on fewer than 5 effective sequences (minimum
## 1.0), often because many sequences share one value of the measure; their depths
## are unstable.
summary(a)
##     group              measure state low_value depth_at_low high_value
## 1 network longitudinal_entropy     A 0.8112781    0.6926388          1
## 2 network longitudinal_entropy     B 0.8112781    0.0000000          1
##   depth_at_high
## 1             0
## 2             0
plot(a)

Tied numeric covariate

s$grade <- c(rep(10,20),20)
t <- landscape_trend(s,along='grade',iter=20,seed=1)
plot(t,type='surface')

Boundary states are included in surface metrics

Prepared start markers now count as sequence positions both when calculating stability measures and when estimating transitions.

d <- data.frame(T1=c('A','B','A','B','A','B'),
                T2=c('B','A','A','B','B','A'),
                T3=c('A','B','B','A','A','B'))
n <- build_network(d,method='relative',params=list(begin_state='A'))
surf <- landscape_surface(n,measure='self_loop_tendency',k=5,n_grid=3)
## Warning: 3 of 3 slices rest on fewer than 5 effective sequences (minimum 2.0),
## often because many sequences share one value of the measure; their depths are
## unstable.
summary(surf)
##     group            measure state low_value depth_at_low high_value
## 1 network self_loop_tendency     A         0 1.271855e-05  0.5833333
## 2 network self_loop_tendency     B         0 1.271830e-05  0.5833333
##   depth_at_high
## 1     0.7230330
## 2     0.2876767
plot(surf)
